gaps.title: Argon2 production dependency is not yet frozen in uv.lock
gaps.impact: Argon2idPasswordHasher intentionally fails closed when argon2-cffi is unavailable. Test doubles prove orchestration only; they are not production password crypto.
gaps.closure: Add a reviewed argon2-cffi version to the workspace dependency set, regenerate uv.lock, and execute hash/verify tests in canonical Python 3.12 CI.

gaps.title: Reference AuthService still uses MemoryAuthStore
gaps.impact: The complete auth behavior is executable in-process, while SQLAlchemy models and migration 0002 are present but not yet wired through a transactional PostgreSQL AuthStore adapter.
gaps.closure: Implement the PostgreSQL auth repository adapter using migration 0002 tables and tenant_session after membership authorization.

gaps.title: Email delivery provider adapter not wired
gaps.impact: Invite and email-verification secrets are generated/hash-stored correctly, but delivery to Mailpit/production provider is not part of the current runtime adapter.
gaps.closure: Wire the existing local Mailpit infrastructure through an AuthMailPort; production provider remains environment-specific.

gaps.title: Hosted runner and PostgreSQL validation pending
gaps.impact: Canonical frozen-install, Argon2 dependency, migration upgrade/downgrade/reapply, RLS and cross-tenant integration evidence cannot be promoted to PASS until GitHub Actions receives a runner.
gaps.closure: Resolve the repository/account Actions billing or spending-limit condition, then run NODE-16 and repository security gates.
